summary: E2E testing of Timesheet v2 (daily-row + leaves). Backend: 32/32 pytest tests passing — auth, employee CRUD, lock (423), Monday validation, future-week rejection, save-day, submit-week, approve/reject, resubmit-after-reject, leave apply/approve/cancel, approved-leave auto-merge into week, pending_leaves in summary, per-day CSV export, daily+Friday reminder endpoints (Resend mocked, sent=0). Frontend: admin employee creation, employee login, lock banner, week-select, 5 daily save-day + submit-week, missing= URL param banner, leave application (Leaves tab), admin leave approve (tab-leaves), review dialog all work. Minor visual issue: Review Timesheet dialog body appears empty/clipped visually although DOM contains correct daily breakdown table (Date,Type,Hours,Tasks with 5 rows).

ui_bugs.issue: Daily breakdown table is rendered in DOM but appears visually clipped/invisible — dialog body between title and Close button shows as empty gray area. Likely DialogContent max-height/overflow or text color issue.

issues: DialogContent likely missing DialogDescription (Radix a11y warning)
Content area appears empty visually despite data being present — check overflow/max-height/text color on dialog body

action_items: Fix visual rendering of Admin ReviewDialog daily breakdown — data is in DOM (table has Date/Type/Hours/Tasks headers + 5 rows) but not visible in viewport. Likely a missing/wrong CSS class on DialogContent scroll container or text color inheriting transparent/muted.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py ~815 lines — consider splitting into routers/{auth,employees,timesheets,leaves,reports,reminders}.py for maintainability.
CORS config: explicit allow_origins=[FRONTEND_URL, 'http://localhost:3000'] with allow_credentials=True is correct — good fix from iteration_1.
bcrypt hashes verified ($2b$ via successful login).
seed_admin is idempotent and updates password if changed — good.

_get_or_create_week uses insert_one then returns local doc — safe, but if two save-day calls race on first save they could both create docs; add unique index on (employee_id, week_start) to enforce. Current index is non-unique (line 782).
delete_employee cascades to timesheets AND leaves — verified by test_delete_employee_cascade.
No brute-force login lockout implemented — not in spec but worth considering for production.
get_week_start uses UTC date which drives lock logic; if users are in different timezones, day-boundary issues possible. Acceptable for MVP.
save-day correctly flips rejected→draft on next save (line 415). Good.
Approved-leave auto-merge in submit_week overwrites existing daily_entries for those dates — correct behavior.
CSV export uses StreamingResponse but builds full content in memory (io.StringIO) — fine for <5000 rows.
test_credentials: admin@timesheet.com / admin123 (seeded). Test employees created at runtime with TST/UI prefix.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral employees (prefixed TST/UI) and clean them up via DELETE /api/employees/{id} which cascades.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Container date=2026-04-27 (Mon). Current week Mon=2026-04-27, Last week Mon=2026-04-20. Resend uses placeholder key — both reminder endpoints return sent=0 without error. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_timesheet_api.py is pytest-native, 32 tests, ~7s. Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_timesheet_api.py. Frontend data-testids confirmed: day-hours-{date}, day-tasks-{date}, day-type-{date}, save-day-{date}, submit-week-button, week-select, tab-leave (employee), tab-leaves (admin), apply-leave-button, leave-type-select, leave-start, leave-end, leave-reason, submit-leave-button, approve-leave-{id}, reject-leave-{id}, emp-id-input, emp-name-input, emp-email-input, emp-password-input, lock-banner, missing-link-banner.
rca of the issue: Review dialog content visually clipped: likely DialogContent CSS uses max-height without overflow-y:auto OR inner table has text-muted-foreground that becomes invisible on the dialog background. Needs inspection of AdminDashboard.jsx ReviewDialog component styling.
